01-introduction.title: I. Introduction
01-introduction.claim: Motivation and the four contribution cards in PLAN.md govern the opening.
01-introduction.boundary: Preserve the current scientific direction. Do not infer compute savings, forgetting or generalization from these diagnostics.

02-related-work.title: II. Stability Analysis of SGD / related work
02-related-work.claim: Specific predecessor roles support the four contributions; the bibliography snapshot preserves current citations.
02-related-work.boundary: The literature review is targeted, with source-reading depth recorded; it is not an exhaustive priority claim.

03-regimes.title: III. Constructive and Destructive Regimes
03-regimes.claim: All-pair accumulation, directional curvature, sampling and finite-step loss share an explicit update clock.
03-regimes.boundary: GD path curvature and Adam mixed response have different meanings. The nonlinear loss relation remains approximate.

04-gd-sgd.title: IV. Empirical Characterization
04-gd-sgd.claim: Retain the four current GD/SGD figures in order; supporting HVP, finite-step and all-lag evidence checks their interpretation.
04-gd-sgd.boundary: Nine GD conditions use one initialization per task; minibatch evidence is replicated. Equal updates do not mean equal data exposure.

05-adam/a-characterization.title: V-A. Adam characterization
05-adam/a-characterization.claim: Exhaustive severity and lead-time evidence supports broad reversal precursors with selective, architecture-dependent amplification.
05-adam/a-characterization.boundary: Individual increases are not independent spikes. Current pre-update associations are exploratory, not a validated forecasting rule.

05-adam/b-tracing.title: V-B. Architectural tracing
05-adam/b-tracing.claim: Fixed-probe consecutive motion reveals stage-specific reversals and structured temporal directions.
05-adam/b-tracing.boundary: SVD is retrospective and permutation invariant; stage association does not identify a unique cause. Original windows/probes must remain explicit.

05-adam/c-intervention.title: V-C. Representation-informed intervention
05-adam/c-intervention.claim: The local affine cap improves selected training-window outcomes; negative controls distinguish direction, amplitude and within-layer allocation.
05-adam/c-intervention.boundary: Training benefits coexist with held-out deterioration. Historical comparators are not one matched benchmark; direct ranking remains pending.

06-conclusion.title: VI. Conclusion
06-conclusion.claim: Conclude with the supported chain from interactions to functional expression and selective control.
06-conclusion.boundary: Retain the explanatory scope and the conditional status of forecasting, generalization, runtime efficiency and broad deployment.

appendices.title: Appendices / technical support
appendices.claim: Retain derivations and complete supporting audits without enlarging the main narrative.
appendices.boundary: Historical manuscript sources are snapshots, not authorization to restore superseded prose.
